column1: # GENERATED SEED, then hand-maintained: one row per whole-program or whole-directory inputs.decl line.
# `#program<TAB><path>` names a shared program: a file whose whole-file key row moves for every edit, however
# narrow. Rows: `<fixture><TAB><declared line, markers included><TAB>whole|legacy`. `whole`: the fixture drives,
# scans or copies the whole program or enumerates the whole directory. `legacy`: not yet narrowed.
# Arm I130 (scripts/validate-enforcement-map.sh) refuses a whole line with no row, a row no inputs.decl carries,
# and a list with more rows than its base copy. scripts/invalidation-guard.sh reads the classes at push time.
